{{Quote|I am Jan-Ira Toru. This is Keelin Zaariq. We are here at the request of Master Devan of the Almas Academy|Jan-Ira Toru|<ref name="TS" />}}
'''Jan-Ira Toru''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Jan-Ira Toru was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] at their [[Almas Academy|experimental academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. Once selected as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], Toru constructed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and was dispatched to serve the Order throughout the [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="TS" />

{{RPG}}
When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] entered into [[Clone Wars/Legends|all out war]], Toru and the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] Padawan [[Keelin Zaariq]] were sent by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Devan For'deschel]] to bring the [[heroes of Cularin]] to the Almas Academy. They flew a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] to [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], where they met with the heroes and told them that For'deschel wished to meet with them. They then flew back to [[Almas]], with the heroes.<ref name="TS" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Twi'light Storm]]'', there are two different ways by which the player characters can be summoned to meet with Master For'deschel, with Zaariq and Toru meeting with them being one of them.
